name: Big Silkscreen Artwork Overlay Tool
description: Compose SVG silkscreen artwork on a PCB with clearance rules, inversion layers and minimum-feature cleanup.
description_full:
Compose SVG artwork directly over a PCB and generate front or back silkscreen. Shared color-based rules provide clearances for exposed copper, existing silkscreen, courtyards, solder mask and custom layers. Includes artwork inversion layers, minimum-feature cleanup, reusable profiles and a separate Update Big Silkscreen Artwork Overlay Tool action.

Windows x64, KiCad 10 with Python 3.11. Dependencies are bundled; no separate installer or first-run downloads are needed. Created with AI assistance and not independently audited.
